title: Neutrino Energy
description: Essential Criteria: The response must include the correct energy of the neutrino in beta decay, approximately 1 MeV.

title: Lifetime Dependence
description: Essential Criteria: The response must correctly state the dependence of the lifetime on atomic number Z as tau proportional to Z^-4.

title: Electron Configuration
description: Essential Criteria: The response must provide the correct electron configuration for atomic oxygen as 1s^2 2s^2 2p^4.

title: Total Spin and Angular Momentum
description: Important Criteria: The response should include the correct values for total spin S, total orbital angular momentum L, and total angular momentum J.

title: Mathematical Derivations
description: Important Criteria: The response should demonstrate understanding of the derivation of the lifetime dependence on Z, including relevant equations.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The response should avoid common errors such as incorrect signs or misinterpretation of the relationship between A and tau.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The response should check for consistency in units when discussing energy and lifetime.

title: Alternative Routes
description: Optional Criteria: The response may include alternative methods or reasoning for arriving at the final answers.
